title: LUMA — AI glasses and a charging case for everyday transitions, 14 deliverables

# LUMA — shared client facts

## Product

- Project name: LUMA.
- Product quantity: one complete adult-use AI glasses concept and one matching charging/storage case.
- Product intent: connected assistance interpreting an intentionally captured image and a short user-initiated spoken question through a paired phone.
- Capture initiation: deliberate user action.
- Physical scope: complete eyewear form, integrated components, contact surfaces, physical controls and charging/storage case.
- Lens configuration: two clear non-display lenses.
- Frame configuration: one bridge with two nose-contact regions, two folding temples and two ear-contact regions.
- Design choices: overall form, component arrangement within permitted regions, colours, hinge construction, folding order and case construction.
- Shared inputs: complete records for tiers 6, 14 and 24.
- Required product marking: LUMA on the glasses and case.
- Required replacement-detail wording: User-replaceable B01.

## Electronic module records

| module_id | name | quantity | local_x_mm | local_y_mm | local_z_mm | permitted_region |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C01 | Compute module | 1 | 28 | 8 | 5 | Either temple |
| B01 | Left battery envelope | 1 | 30 | 7 | 4 | Left temple |
| B02 | Right battery envelope | 1 | 30 | 7 | 4 | Right temple |
| S01 | Left speaker envelope | 1 | 16 | 5 | 3 | Left temple near ear |
| S02 | Right speaker envelope | 1 | 16 | 5 | 3 | Right temple near ear |
| K01 | Camera envelope | 1 | 8 | 8 | 6 | One outer front-frame corner |
| M01 | Microphone envelope | 1 | 4 | 3 | 2 | Frame or forward temple |
| I01 | Capture indicator envelope | 1 | 3 | 2 | 1 | Front beside K01 |
| CB01 | Case battery envelope | 1 | 45 | 25 | 6 | Case |
| CC01 | Case charging-board envelope | 1 | 20 | 15 | 4 | Case |
| U01 | Case input connector envelope | 1 | 12 | 5 | 7 | Case wall |

## Envelope integration

- Dimension basis: rectangular local X/Y/Z keep-out envelopes in mm.
- Module instances: exactly the quantities in the module table.
- Envelope orientation: rotation permitted; original dimensions retained; local axes identified in the anatomy.
- Envelope separation: at least 1 mm between separate envelopes.
- Enclosure allowance: at least 1 mm outside each solid envelope except at its functional opening.
- Glasses module set: C01, B01, B02, S01, S02, K01, M01, I01.
- Case module set: CB01, CC01, U01.
- Wiring representation: schematic routes between the recorded modules.
- Batteries: enclosed envelopes.
- Functional openings: camera, speakers and microphone; remaining module surfaces enclosed.
- U01 interface: USB-C-shaped input-connector envelope, socket mouth exposed at the case wall.
- Case charging context: unplugged operation from its internal battery.
- B01 service arrangement: user-accessible cover, detachable connection and illustrated removal direction.

## Physical dimensions

| Feature | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Open-glasses overall front width | Selected value from 140 to 150 mm |
| Each temple, hinge axis to tip along centreline | Selected value from 135 to 150 mm |
| Each temple, largest section height | At most 18 mm |
| Each temple, largest section thickness | At most 12 mm |
| Folded glasses envelope, width × depth × height | At most 150 × 60 × 48 mm |
| Closed case envelope, width × depth × height | At most 170 × 85 × 65 mm |
| Usable cavity clearance | At least 2 mm on each opposing side of all three axes of the selected folded envelope |
| Local clearance exceptions | Explicitly marked support and charging-contact interfaces |
| Glasses mass target | At most 42 g; unmeasured |

- Dimension records: actual selected open width, both temple lengths, largest temple sections, folded width/depth/height, cavity width/depth/height and closed-case width/depth/height.
- Contact surfaces: smooth rounded transitions and compliant nose/ear material.
- Skin-contact zoning: smooth surfaces separated from sharp edges, open ports and charging pads.
- Speaker openings: outward/downward near the ears; ear canals remain open.
- K01 position: forward-facing at one selected outer front-frame corner.
- K01 clear optical aperture: diameter 4 mm.
- I01 position: outward on the front; centre within 12 mm of the camera-aperture centre; visible with the shutter closed.
- M01 opening: outward, away from skin and the hinge.
- Capture button: reachable while worn, with the camera aperture clear and lenses free from finger pressure.
- Hinge relationship: each rigid module wholly on one side of a moving hinge.
- Folding relationship: separate, non-intersecting temple volumes in the folded state.

## Two-pad docking

| Element | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Glasses pad location | Underside of the right temple |
| Glasses pad quantity and labels | Exactly two; P+ and P− |
| Glasses pad geometry | Circular, flush, diameter 2 mm |
| Glasses pad spacing | 6 mm centre to centre along the temple |
| Pad-centre region | Both within the first 60 mm from the hinge axis towards the tip |
| Pad order | P+ nearer the hinge; P− nearer the tip |
| Pad-centre positions | Selected distances recorded in the design |
| Case contact tips | Two; diameter 1.2 mm; 6 mm centre spacing |
| Polarity alignment | P+ to P+ and P− to P− |
| Contact faces | Parallel at docking |
| Docking orientation | Visible locating/keying feature identifying the matching orientation |
| Docking state | Fully folded glasses; privacy slider closed |
| Charging state | Glasses seated; both pads mated; separate case indicator steadily amber |
| Stored/idle state | Same glasses seated; case indicator off; case closed |
| Case indicator location | Visible with the lid closed |
| Case support | Frame/temple regions; lenses clear of direct supporting pressure |
| Closed-lid relationship | All components contained within the closed case |
| Removal access | Finger access to frame/temple regions |
| Empty-case state | Open cavity with the same supports, contacts and locating feature |
| Prototype topics | Spring travel, force and circuit protection |

## Operating states

| State | Camera aperture | Front capture indicator | Control and capture behaviour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| READY | Uncovered | Off | Ready for deliberate user initiation; no active capture |
| CAPTURE | Uncovered | Steadily white during the illustrated active interval | Visible user-operated capture button; active capture |
| PRIVACY | Entire aperture covered by an opaque physical slider | Off | Visible physical position mark; camera and microphone capture disabled; pressing capture does not start capture |

## Wearing and handling contexts

| Code | Name | Context | Glasses state | View and handling facts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| W1 | everyday | Adult standing during a quiet urban pause | READY | Fully open glasses on the face; three-quarter upper-body view; close inset of nose/ear placement |
| W2 | work pause | Adult seated at a desk | PRIVACY | Glasses worn; closed shutter visible; hand near the reachable capture button; capture inhibited |
| W3 | commute pause | Adult standing in a stationary sheltered transit waiting area | READY | Clear side view of the same temple and ear contact |
| W4 | cafe pause | Adult at a cafe table | PRIVACY | Same fully folded glasses held by the frame/temple region before placement in the same open case; shutter closed; charging indication off before contact; consistent relative scale |

- Board labels: W codes and corresponding READY or PRIVACY state labels.
- People, clothing and surroundings: open design choices within the recorded contexts.
- Product continuity: selected dimensions and component identities shared across every context.
- Face geometry: open; contact-zone illustration supplies relative locations.
- Contact/operation insets: part of their parent boards.

## Materials and development records

- Frame and temple shells: TR90; satin finish.
- Hinges: anodised aluminium.
- Nose and ear contact surfaces: silicone; smooth rounded transitions.
- Case materials and finishes: selected in the design.
- Colour palette: selected in the design; colour codes recorded with material applications.
- Prototype topics: mass, fit/comfort, hinge life, thermal behaviour, charging reliability and capture/privacy interlock.
- Unspecified performance fields: component mass, battery capacity, runtime, charging time, optical prescription, waterproof rating and drop rating.
- U01 unspecified electrical fields: standard, power rating and charging protocol.
- Source ownership: original repository-authored text, local component drawings and records; redistributable with the commission.

steps.userMessage:
LUMA | AI glasses and a charging case for everyday transitions

We are developing LUMA for adults who want to capture a moment during an urban pause and move comfortably between work and leisure. The system comprises one complete pair of AI glasses and one matching charging/storage case. Connected assistance uses an intentionally captured image and a short, user-initiated spoken question through a paired phone. The glasses themselves are the main design task: two clear non-display lenses, a complete frame, folding temples, integrated electronics, comfortable contact surfaces and reachable physical controls. Print "LUMA" on the glasses and case.

The glasses mass target is at most 42 g. Choose a front width of 140–150 mm and a hinge-axis-to-tip centreline length of 135–150 mm for each temple; the largest temple section is at most 18 mm high and 12 mm thick. Folded glasses fit within 150 × 60 × 48 mm; the closed case fits within 170 × 85 × 65 mm, with at least 2 mm cavity clearance on each opposing side of the chosen folded envelope. Use the eleven recorded electronic modules, with 1 mm between envelopes and 1 mm enclosure outside them except at functional openings. The right-temple underside carries two flush pads of diameter 2 mm, spaced 6 mm centre to centre, both within 60 mm of the hinge; P+ is nearer the hinge. Matching case tips have diameter 1.2 mm. Use satin TR90 for the frame and temple shells, anodised aluminium hinges and silicone nose and ear contact surfaces. Develop the colour palette. Make B01 accessible for user replacement and print "User-replaceable B01" beside its removal detail.

The three glasses states are READY, CAPTURE and PRIVACY. READY exposes the camera with its indicator off; CAPTURE exposes the camera with a steady white front indicator; PRIVACY closes an opaque slider over the camera and disables camera and microphone capture. Give the slider a visible position mark. Folded glasses dock with the slider closed; the case indicator is steady amber during charging and off during stored/idle. Its indicator remains visible with the lid closed. Label these states on their corresponding design boards.

Audience: the product owner, industrial design team and engineering team, choosing the complete eyewear concept and preparing its first development brief.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the shared product, fit, operation, material and context facts. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists each deliverable's proportion, format and stage. 03-module-records.md contains the eleven electronic module records. module-envelopes.en.md gives their local dimensions and permitted regions. charging-interface.en.md records pad geometry and mating relationships. module-and-docking-constraints.png diagrams the module envelopes and local charging interface. wearer-contact-map.png supplies the shared wearer and contact-zone reference across the directions. everyday-pause-reference.png supplies atmosphere for an urban pause and a warm office desk.

Deliverables:
1. Three distinct complete-product direction boards, each showing the glasses open and folded beside their matching case
2. One written selection sheet naming the chosen direction and the frame, temple and case decisions carried forward
3. One component and state specification sheet listing all eleven module IDs, envelope dimensions, connections, selected product dimensions, pad-centre positions, contact materials and visible operating-state changes
4. One selected-glasses anatomy board with front, top and right orthographic views, module placement and local axes, schematic wiring, chosen dimensions and an exploded B01 replacement detail
5. Three operation and wearing boards: W1 everyday in READY with a nose/ear inset, CAPTURE with button reach and the white indicator, and W2 work pause in PRIVACY with the closed slider and button inhibition
6. Two case boards: open charging with a mating-contact section, modules, cavity dimensions and removal access; closed stored/idle with an empty open-case inset and outer dimensions
7. One material and colour application board for the selected glasses and case, naming materials, finishes, colour codes and compliant contact zones
8. One 12-second use-and-storage video moving through READY, CAPTURE, PRIVACY, folded docking with amber charging indication and closed-case stored/idle
9. One development presentation of at least 8 pages, reusing the directions, selection, specification, anatomy, operation, case and material work

Acceptance:
- On the three direction boards, present three named alternatives before the selection sheet; on that sheet and the presentation's first page, identify one selected direction, then develop its frame, temples and case in the specification and every subsequent application.
- On the specification, anatomy and case boards, repeat the same selected open and folded dimensions and pad-centre positions; dimension the 140–150 mm front-width range, 135–150 mm temple-length range, 18 × 12 mm section limit, 150 × 60 × 48 mm folded limit, 170 × 85 × 65 mm case limit and at least 2 mm cavity clearance on all six sides except marked support/contact interfaces.
- On the specification and anatomy board, repeat the eight glasses module IDs and recorded envelopes; on the specification and charging board, repeat CB01, CC01 and U01 and their recorded envelopes. Show 1 mm envelope separation and enclosure, functional openings, K01's 4 mm aperture, I01 within 12 mm of its centre, and B01's access cover, detachable connection and removal arrow labelled User-replaceable B01 on the anatomy board.
- On the specification, three operation boards, video and presentation, repeat READY, CAPTURE and PRIVACY with the prescribed camera, light and slider states; label W1 and W2 on their assigned boards, show silicone nose/ear contact in W1, and show the reachable button with camera/microphone capture disabled in W2 PRIVACY.
- On the case boards and in the video, use the same fully folded glasses with the slider closed, keyed seating and frame/temple supports; on the charging board, dimension the 2 mm pads, 6 mm spacing and 1.2 mm tips, with P+ nearer the hinge and both centres within 60 mm. Show the case indicator steady amber while charging and off in closed stored/idle, plus the empty cavity and removal access on the case boards.
- On the material board and presentation, name satin TR90 shells, anodised aluminium hinges and silicone contacts and repeat the selected colour codes; carry those surfaces and colours through the anatomy, wearing, operation, case boards and video. Show LUMA on the glasses and case, and reuse those labelled views in the presentation's minimum 8 pages.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
